r20.text: To create a web form in Desk, follow these steps: 1. Go to Settings > "Channels" > "Help Center" and click "Create Help Center". 2. Configure it and click "Save". Ticket forms live under the Help Center pages. 3. Web forms are at /settings/channels/web-forms (use "New advanced form"). This is from the Desk guide titled "Help Center and web forms."
